facts.fact: The myScheme page for PM Vishwakarma is https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/pmv (slug 'pmv'); it opens on the PM Vishwakarma scheme of the Ministry of MSME
facts.quote: PM Vishwakarma is a Central Sector Scheme launched by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises to provide holistic and end-to-end support to artisans and craftspeople
facts.note: The guessed slug /schemes/pm-vishwakarma returns only the site shell ('Something went wrong'), not the scheme.

behaviour: Gives the myScheme scheme page URL from the record, https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/pmv, which opens (HTTP 200) on PM Vishwakarma; no fabricated slug.
fail_if: It gives a made-up myScheme slug (e.g. /schemes/pm-vishwakarma, which does not open the scheme) or a non-government link.
summary: PM Vishwakarma's myScheme page is /schemes/pmv (opens on the scheme); /schemes/pm-vishwakarma does not.
